# ForgePoint Signal — Archived Reference Implementation

> Status: archived May 2026 under ForgePoint Industries. The site is preserved as a portfolio artifact and a reference implementation, not as an active commercial offering.

ForgePoint Signal was a working production proof of the monetized-MCP build pattern: a daily-updated feed of US federal regulatory changes (Federal Register + IRS Internal Revenue Bulletin), parsed by Claude into structured JSON, and served via MCP with x402 micropayments wired in on Base mainnet.

## What this is now

- A read-only feed of regulatory updates at https://forgepointsignal.com (free, no signup).
- A live MCP endpoint demonstrating the x402 + MCP architecture pattern.
- A full open-source repo at https://github.com/Godspeed2077/ForgePoint-Signal.
- A dev.to writeup at https://dev.to/godspeed2077.

## MCP Server (architecture demonstration)

Endpoint: https://forgepointsignal.com/mcp
Transport: HTTP POST with SSE
Protocol: MCP 2024-11-05

The endpoint remains live so the architecture can be inspected. It is no longer being actively marketed or supported. The tools below were originally priced at $0.10 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet; that pricing wiring is preserved in the code as part of the reference implementation.

## Tools

### preview_regulations (free)
Returns the 5 most recent regulatory entries. No payment required.

### search_regulations (originally priced)
Search the full database by keyword, jurisdiction, category, or impact level.

### get_regulation_detail (originally priced)
Get complete detail for a specific entry by ID.

### get_recent_by_impact (originally priced)
Get recent entries filtered by impact level (high/medium/low).

## Data Sources

- Federal Register (federalregister.gov)
- IRS Internal Revenue Bulletin (irs.gov/irb)

## Update Frequency

Daily via automated cron (Federal Register + IRS Internal Revenue Bulletin).

## Use Cases (historical positioning)

- Daily regulatory briefings for estate attorneys
- Monitoring material tax law changes
- AI agent research on US inheritance and gift tax updates
